binance_futures_ping.desc: Test connectivity to Binance USDT-M Futures REST API and measure server-time skew. No auth required. Call this first when signed requests fail with error -1021 (timestamp outside recvWindow).

binance_futures_exchange_info.desc: Get current exchange trading rules and ALL symbol information. No auth required. Response is large — use binance_futures_symbol_specs for a compact per-symbol view when you only need filters for one symbol.

params.symbol: Optional single symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT) to return only that symbol's info. Omit to return all symbols.

binance_futures_symbol_specs.desc: Compact per-symbol trading specs: minNotional (minimum order size in USDT), minQty, stepSize, tickSize, pricePrecision, quantityPrecision, maxLeverage, allowed orderTypes, and contractType. No auth required. Call this before placing an order to size correctly and avoid -1111 (bad precision) and -4164 (below minNotional) errors.

binance_futures_klines.desc: Get OHLCV candlestick data for technical analysis. No auth required. Results returned in ASCENDING order (oldest first, newest last). Each candle: [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, quoteVolume, trades, takerBuyBase, takerBuyQuote, ignore]. For pre-computed indicators (ATR, EMA, RSI, Bollinger), use binance_futures_ta_snapshot instead.

params.limit: Number of candles to return. Default 500, max 1500.
params.start_time_ms: Optional start time in milliseconds since epoch.
params.end_time_ms: Optional end time in milliseconds since epoch.

binance_futures_ticker_price.desc: Get latest mark/last price for one symbol, or ALL symbols if omitted. No auth required. To scan the market for opportunities, use binance_futures_market_scan instead — it returns a ranked list and avoids a 284 KB all-symbols dump.

params.symbol: Optional symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT). Omit to return all symbols.

binance_futures_ticker_24hr.desc: 24-hour rolling statistics: priceChange, priceChangePercent, high, low, volume, quoteVolume, weightedAvgPrice. No auth required. Omitting symbol returns all symbols — heavy response. Use binance_futures_market_scan to get a ranked top-N list instead.

params.symbol: Optional symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT). Omit to return all symbols.

binance_futures_market_scan.desc: Fast market scanner: fetches all 24h tickers, filters by minimum USDT volume, and returns the top N symbols sorted by volume or absolute price change. Use this as the FIRST call when the user asks to find something to trade — replaces a raw ticker_24hr all-symbols dump (284 KB) with a compact ranked list. No auth required.

params.sort_by: Sort criterion: "volume" (default, highest quoteVolume first) or "change_pct" (largest absolute 24h price change first).
params.limit: Number of symbols to return. Default 20, max 50.
params.min_volume_usdt: Minimum 24h quoteVolume in USDT. Default 100000000 (100M). Lower to 10M for altcoins.

binance_futures_order_book.desc: Order book depth (bids and asks) for slippage estimation before placing a market order. No auth required.

binance_futures_mark_price.desc: Current mark price, index price, next funding rate, and next funding time. No auth required. Omit symbol to return all symbols. Funding rate drives holding cost on perpetual futures — check before opening long-duration positions.

params.symbol: Optional symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT). Omit to return all symbols.

binance_futures_open_interest.desc: Open interest (total outstanding contracts) for a symbol. No auth required. Set history=true to return the timeseries — useful for detecting trend acceleration or exhaustion. Note: history endpoint returns empty on testnet.

params.history: If true, return historical open interest instead of the current value. Default false.
params.period: History interval when history=true. One of: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 12h, 1d. Default 1h.
params.limit: Number of history data points when history=true. Default 30, max 500.

binance_futures_long_short_ratio.desc: Long/short account ratio — market sentiment signal. No auth required. Returns timeseries of longAccount, shortAccount, longShortRatio. mode=top uses top-trader data; mode=global uses all accounts. Note: returns empty on testnet.

params.limit: Number of data points. Default 30, max 500.

binance_futures_funding_rate_history.desc: Historical funding rates for a symbol. No auth required. USDT-M Futures fund every 8 hours (00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC). Negative rates mean shorts pay longs (bullish-leaning); positive means longs pay shorts (bearish-leaning). Use to time entries around funding events or gauge directional bias.

params.limit: Number of funding events to return. Default 100, max 1000.
params.start_time_ms: Optional start time in milliseconds since epoch.
params.end_time_ms: Optional end time in milliseconds since epoch.

binance_futures_open_orders.desc: List all currently working (unfilled) orders. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Returns {regular_orders, algo_orders, total} by default — algo_orders contains SL/TP conditional orders from bracket positions. Set include_algo_orders=false to get a raw array of regular orders only.

params.include_algo_orders: If true (default), fetches and merges conditional algo orders (SL/TP) alongside regular orders. Set false to return only regular orders as a raw array.

binance_futures_order_history.desc: Historical orders (filled, canceled, expired, rejected) for a symbol. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET.

params.limit: Max orders to return. Default 50, max 1000.
params.start_time_ms: Optional start time in milliseconds since epoch.
params.end_time_ms: Optional end time in milliseconds since epoch.

binance_futures_income_history.desc: Realized PnL, commissions, funding fees, and referral kickbacks. Use this to evaluate trading performance. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET.

params.income_type: Optional income type: REALIZED_PNL, COMMISSION, FUNDING_FEE, REFERRAL_KICKBACK, etc.
params.start_time_ms: Optional start time in milliseconds since epoch.
params.end_time_ms: Optional end time in milliseconds since epoch.

binance_futures_position_overview.desc: Pre-trade snapshot in one call: account balance, margin usage, open positions with uPnL, and per-symbol maker/taker fees. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Call this first before sizing a new trade — it gives you free margin, current risk exposure, and fee costs in a single round-trip.

params.symbol: Optional symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT) to include commission rate and focused position data.

binance_futures_ta_snapshot.desc: Technical analysis snapshot: fetches klines and computes ATR(14), EMA(9/21/50), RSI(14), and Bollinger Bands(20, 2σ) server-side. No auth required. Returns indicator values for the most recent close plus optionally the underlying candles. Saves tokens vs computing indicators from raw klines. Use ATR for SL/TP sizing (1.5–3× ATR typical), EMA for trend, RSI for overbought/oversold, Bollinger for volatility envelope. EMA(50) requires ≥50 candles — below 21 the call returns an error.

params.limit: Number of candles to fetch. Default 100, max 500.
params.include_candles: If true, include the underlying klines in the response. Default false — only indicators.

binance_futures_ta_snapshot_multi.desc: Batch TA snapshot for multiple symbols in parallel. Computes ATR(14), EMA(9/21/50), RSI(14), and Bollinger Bands(20, 2σ) for each symbol concurrently. No auth required. Returns a list of snapshots and a map of per-symbol errors. Use this instead of multiple ta_snapshot calls when scanning trade candidates.

params.symbols: Comma-separated list of symbols (e.g. BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT,SOLUSDT). Required.
params.limit: Number of candles to fetch per symbol. Default 100, max 500. EMA(50) requires ≥50 candles.
params.include_candles: If true, include the underlying klines in each snapshot. Default false — only indicators.

binance_futures_calc_order_size.desc: Calculate properly rounded order quantity from a desired USDT notional. No auth required — reads symbol specs and mark price only. Returns quantity (rounded to stepSize/quantityPrecision), actual notional, min/max qty validation, and whether minNotional is met. Call this before place_bracket_order to avoid -1111 (bad precision) and -4164 (below minNotional) errors.

params.desired_notional_usdt: Target position size in USDT (e.g. 50 = buy $50 worth). Required.
params.price: Optional price per unit. If omitted, uses current mark price (suitable for MARKET orders).
params.order_type: MARKET (default) or LIMIT. Affects which lot-size filter is applied (MARKET_LOT_SIZE vs LOT_SIZE).

binance_futures_position_health.desc: Health snapshot of all open positions: SL/TP distances from mark price, PnL%, PnL% on margin, structural validity of SL/TP placement, and remaining R:R. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Fetches position_risk and open algo orders concurrently. Surfaces duplicate or missing SL/TP orders so you can act immediately.

params.symbol: Optional symbol to filter (e.g. BTCUSDT). Omit to return all open positions.

binance_futures_daily_summary.desc: Daily P&L summary: aggregates realized PnL, commissions, funding fees, and net profit for a UTC day. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Returns trading_net_profit (PnL + fees + funding) and account_net_profit (includes all income types). Warns if the 1000-row API limit is hit. Ideal for end-of-day review.

params.date: Date to summarize in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). Defaults to today UTC.
params.symbol: Optional symbol to filter (e.g. BTCUSDT). Omit to summarize all symbols.

binance_futures_position_brief.desc: Morning/monitoring snapshot in one call: open positions with SL/TP distances and R:R, today's P&L summary, and free margin. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Replaces position_health + daily_summary in a single call. Surfaces attention_needed items: missing SL/TP, low R:R, duplicate orders.

binance_futures_configure_symbol.desc: MUTATING. Set leverage and/or margin_type for a symbol. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog — the result prefix in the response tells you how it was resolved: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)". ⚠️ Do NOT call this before place_bracket_order — pass leverage and margin_type directly to place_bracket_order to avoid triggering extra confirmation dialogs.

params.leverage: Target leverage 1–125 (symbol-dependent). Omit to leave unchanged.
params.margin_type: ISOLATED or CROSSED. ISOLATED caps loss to position margin. Omit to leave unchanged.
params.reasoning: Why this configuration is appropriate — shown to the user in the confirmation dialog. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.

binance_futures_change_position_mode.desc: MUTATING. Account-wide switch: hedge mode (dual LONG+SHORT positions per symbol) or one-way (single position). Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog. Must have no open positions or orders when switching. Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.dual_side_position: true = hedge mode, false = one-way mode. Required.
params.reasoning: Why this mode change is appropriate. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.

binance_futures_place_order.desc: MUTATING. Place a single USDT-M Futures order (MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET, TRAILING_STOP_MARKET). Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog — use dry_run=true first to validate without placing or confirming. Auto-generates an idempotent newClientOrderId if omitted. IMPORTANT: on HTTP 503 'Unknown error', the tool reconciles via order lookup before returning — do NOT retry without checking the response. For entry + SL + TP atomically, prefer binance_futures_place_bracket_order. Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.type: Order type: MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET, TRAILING_STOP_MARKET. Required.
params.quantity: Base-asset quantity. Required unless close_position=true. Rounded to stepSize.
params.price: Limit price — required for LIMIT, STOP, TAKE_PROFIT.
params.stop_price: Trigger price — required for STOP, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET.
params.time_in_force: GTC (default for LIMIT), IOC, FOK, GTX (post-only), GTD.
params.good_till_date_ms: Required when time_in_force=GTD. Auto-cancel timestamp in ms.
params.reduce_only: If true, order can only reduce an existing position. Ignored in hedge mode — use position_side there.
params.close_position: If true (STOP_MARKET/TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET only), closes the entire position. quantity is ignored.
params.position_side: Hedge mode only: LONG, SHORT, or BOTH (default one-way).
params.working_type: MARK_PRICE or CONTRACT_PRICE (default). Which price triggers conditional orders.
params.price_match: NONE (default), OPPONENT, OPPONENT_5/10/20, QUEUE, QUEUE_5/10/20. When set, price is auto-chosen and the price param is ignored.
params.price_protect: If true, conditional orders reject when trigger is too far from mark price.
params.new_client_order_id: Optional custom client order ID (≤36 chars, [0-9A-Za-z_.-]). Auto-generated if omitted.
params.dry_run: If true, validates via POST /fapi/v1/order/test without placing. Skips the confirmation dialog. Use this first before live execution.
params.reasoning: Mandatory when dry_run=false: strategy, signals, and risk rationale. Shown in the confirmation dialog.

binance_futures_place_bracket_order.desc: MUTATING. Recommended primary trade entry: places entry + stop-loss + take-profit atomically in one call. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows ONE confirmation dialog even when leverage/margin_type are also being set. Client-side validates SL is on the loss side and TP on the profit side. Pre-validates minimum notional before confirmation. ⚠️ Pass leverage and margin_type directly here — do NOT call configure_symbol separately first, as that triggers extra confirmation dialogs. Use dry_run=true first to validate all legs without placing or confirming. Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.side: BUY (long) or SELL (short) for the entry. Required.
params.type: Entry order type — MARKET or LIMIT. Required.
params.quantity: Base-asset quantity for the entry. Required.
params.stop_loss_price: Trigger price for the STOP_MARKET exit leg. Required.
params.take_profit_price: Trigger price for the TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET exit leg. Required.
params.leverage: Optional — if set, calls configure_symbol internally. Pass here instead of calling configure_symbol separately.
params.margin_type: Optional ISOLATED or CROSSED — if set, calls configure_symbol internally. Recommend ISOLATED for discrete AI trades. Pass here instead of calling configure_symbol separately.
params.working_type: MARK_PRICE or CONTRACT_PRICE (default) for SL/TP triggers.
params.time_in_force: Only for LIMIT entry. Default GTC.
params.on_partial_failure: "rollback" (default) — cancel successful legs on any failure; or "warn" — return a warning and leave partial state for you to resolve.
params.dry_run: If true, validates each leg via /fapi/v1/order/test without placing. Skips the confirmation dialog. Use this first.
params.reasoning: Mandatory when dry_run=false: full strategy, entry thesis, SL/TP logic, R:R, and sizing rationale. Shown in the confirmation dialog.

binance_futures_cancel_order.desc: MUTATING. Cancel a single order by orderId or origClientOrderId. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog. Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.order_id: Order ID. Provide either this or orig_client_order_id.
params.orig_client_order_id: Client order ID. Provide either this or order_id.
params.reasoning: Why this order is being cancelled. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.

binance_futures_cancel_all_open_orders.desc: MUTATING. Cancel ALL working orders for a symbol. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog. Does not close positions — only removes pending orders. Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.reasoning: Why all orders are being cancelled. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.

binance_futures_close_position.desc: MUTATING. Close an open position via reduceOnly MARKET order (or LIMIT if price is provided). Auto-detects position size and side from /fapi/v2/positionRisk — no need to compute the opposite side yourself. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog. Returns an error if the position is already zero. Use dry_run=true to validate without execution. Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.quantity: Optional quantity to close. Omit to close the entire position.
params.price: Optional LIMIT price. Omit for MARKET close.
params.time_in_force: Only when price is set. GTC (default), IOC, FOK.
params.position_side: Hedge mode only: LONG or SHORT. Omit for one-way mode.
params.dry_run: If true, validates via /fapi/v1/order/test without execution. Skips confirmation dialog.
params.reasoning: Why the position is being closed. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true or dry_run=true.

binance_futures_modify_order.desc: MUTATING. Modify an existing LIMIT order's price and/or quantity via PUT /fapi/v1/order. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog. Use this to tighten SL, widen TP, or re-price a stale LIMIT without the cancel-and-replace race window. Only works for LIMIT orders — STOP and TAKE_PROFIT orders cannot be modified (cancel and replace instead). Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.side: BUY or SELL. Required by Binance — must match the original order's side.
params.order_id: Order ID to modify. Provide either this or orig_client_order_id.
params.orig_client_order_id: Client order ID to modify. Provide either this or order_id.
params.quantity: New quantity. Omit to keep current.
params.price: New price. Omit to keep current.
params.reasoning: Why the order is being modified. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.

binance_futures_cancel_algo_order.desc: MUTATING. Cancel a single algo/conditional order (SL or TP) by algoId. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog. Use binance_futures_open_orders (algo_orders field) to find the algoId. Use this to clean up orphaned SL/TP orders after a position is closed manually. Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.algo_id: The algoId of the conditional order to cancel. Get from binance_futures_open_orders, algo_orders field.
params.reasoning: Why this algo order is being cancelled. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.

binance_futures_update_sl_tp.desc: MUTATING. Cancel existing SL/TP algo orders and place new ones atomically for an open position. Auto-detects existing SL/TP from algo orders and replaces them. Validates SL/TP placement vs entry price (SL must be on loss side, TP on profit side). Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Shows a confirmation dialog. Response prefix: "Confirmed by user (human approval)" or "Auto-approved (BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true)".

params.stop_loss_price: New stop-loss trigger price. Omit to leave stop-loss unchanged.
params.take_profit_price: New take-profit trigger price. Omit to leave take-profit unchanged.
params.working_type: MARK_PRICE or CONTRACT_PRICE (default) for SL/TP triggers.
params.reasoning: Why this update is being made. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.
